title: HumanGatePayload
description: What a human reviewer sees before deciding an approve-tier action (binder ch18 C5; human-gate-designer). Gate BEFORE the action for irreversible effects. blastRadius MUST be computed from the actual command/target (a real git status --porcelain or filesystem preview), never restated from the agent's own claim — the whole point of the gate is that the agent's self-report is not trusted. Options always include modify (binary approve/reject is an anti-pattern). The decision routes back as an approval_result TranscriptEvent and, when denied, a DenialReceipt.

envelopeId.description: The pre-tool ToolGateEnvelope (decision: held) this gate belongs to.

requestedBy.description: Agent node / session id that attempted the action.

context.description: Why the agent believes this is necessary, verbatim — shown as claim, not truth.

blastRadius.description: Computed, not asserted. What would actually be affected if this ran.

computedBy.description: The read-only probe that produced the preview, e.g. "git status --porcelain".

options.description: Always all three: approve, reject, modify.

expiresAt.description: A gate that never expires is a hung agent; expiry resolves as reject (fail closed).
